name: sprites-batch2
goal: 2차 스프라이트 배치 — 나머지 테마(편의점·빵집·치킨·붕어빵·택배·세차·노래방) 인게임 오브젝트 20종. 골든 레퍼런스 앵커, 0.5초 판독성 최우선.
style: bold clean dark outlines, vibrant high-saturation colors, energetic comic cartoon sticker style, playful slightly exaggerated chunky proportions, flat cel shading with one simple gloss highlight
common: single centered object, isolated on a fully transparent background, no text, no watermark, no logo, no lettering of any kind, 1024x1024 PNG with alpha, generous ~12% margin, slight 3/4 top-down angle, instantly readable silhouette even at small size
